overallVerdict: Round-7 evidence is authentic and honest: the H3 bounded runner, H7-round7 mapping and X+1 clean artifacts match their hashes/counts and do not upgrade product rows; the fixed-host attempt is correctly recorded as a FAILED create with GOAL_OPERATION_UNKNOWN (0 evaluate attempts, 0 model requests, no retry), and the evidence explicitly discloses the durable unauthorized/paused Goal row + core Goal Session, the receipt businessSideEffects.goal.created=false contradiction, and the absence of Task/Effect/budget/artifact/event/state changes. The only substantive gap is F7-R1: the H3 offline create-failure test assumes side-effect-free failure and the runner does not read back after a create error, so the partial-create side effect seen on the host is not covered offline (host evidence corrects it); plus F7-R2 historical evaluations labelling. No evidence was found that masks the failure or claims real business completion.
